pdp_details_sections.heading: Overview
pdp_details_sections.body: An enriching everyday moisturiser for normal skin. Combining Lilly Pilly extract with Omega 3 oils.

pdp_details_sections.heading: Benefits
pdp_details_sections.body:
Lilly Pilly, a bush medicine of Indigenous Australians for internal and external healing, assists the repair of weathered skin.The astringent extract of Lilly Pilly provides gentle exfoliation, leaving the skin smooth.

The high concentration of antioxidants in the Omega 3 combination of Rice Bran and Macadamia oils helps restore skin balance.

These oils are natural moisturisers, protecting the skin from sun damage and wrinkle formation.

pdp_details_sections.heading: How to Use
pdp_details_sections.body:
twice-daily on face
at night with the kakadu plum vitamin c face serum for a deeper moisturisation
